messages:
maria: FYI — runtime engine release scheduled for change window 2024-06-22 00:00–01:00 UTC. Contains kernel matmul v5 and new quant build q8_0. Canary rollout 1% -> 5% -> 20%. Pinning disabled models to v1.14.0 for now. please stand by for deploy-bot msg.

maria: TL;DR risks: small perf regress on long-seq (2k+) observed in staging with q8_0, but memory/cost savings look good. we need to watch latency P95 and token throughput.

maria: Deploy plan snippet: 
```
# canary schedule
deploy runtime-engine v1.14.0-kv5-q8_0 --canary 1% --wait 5m
# if green -> bump to 5% then 20%
```

deploy-bot: STARTING CANARY: runtime-engine v1.14.0-kv5-q8_0 at 1719001500. Canary 1%. Tracking P50,P95,error-rate. Logs -> https://ci/reports/171900/engine-canary

ajay: smoke tests done on canary instances. basic correctness OK. but microbenchmark shows +11% P95 on seq=2048 on p4dn. cpu-side kernel counters show increased L2 misses during matmul window. attaching flame snippet.

ajay: flame: `matmul_kernel_v5 -> pack_A -> gemm_inner` hotspots around AVX fallback path.

sophia: interesting — quantization changes could change memory access patterns. did staging use the same batch distribution as prod?\
ajay: staging used batched tests (B=1..8) — prod traffic has bursts of B=1 and B=32. we saw regressions mostly at B=1, long seq.

noah: ops-oncall, how close to SLO on that canary?

ops-oncall: P95 at canary: baseline 78ms -> now 86ms on q8_0 at 1% (region-eu-west). error-rate unchanged. Token throughput per GPU down ~3%. Not catastrophic but exceeds our targeted perf delta (5%).

maria: OK — decision call: HOLD progressive rollout at 1%. Do not promote to 5%. ajay, can you try pinning kernel matmul back to v4 for q8_0 build and rerun smoke in staging? If that fails, we rollback q8_0 and keep q4_8 build.

ajay: on it. quick test plan: rebuild runtime with `--kernel matmul:v4` + q8_0 to isolate kernel vs quant. running now. Expected in ~18m.

ci-bot: BUILD STARTED: runtime v1.14.0-kv4-q8_0 (#bld-1719002)

maria: also add a perf histogram of seq lengths and batch-size to the canary dashboard. want to see distribution skew.

ci-bot: BUILD PASSED: runtime v1.14.0-kv4-q8_0 (#bld-1719002) — deploy-bot queued canary re-run.

deploy-bot: RE-STARTING CANARY: runtime v1.14.0-kv4-q8_0 at 1719003000. Canary 1%.

ajay: quick results: P95 now 80ms (closer to baseline). latency tail improved significantly on seq=2048. throughput back within 2% of baseline.

noah: good. any functional regressions?

ajay: none observed. llm outputs match sample prompts. QA spot-check pass.

maria: decision: proceed with cautious promotion to 5% in 15m. leave rollback policy: auto rollback if P95 > baseline +8% or error-rate increases >0.5%.

deploy-bot: PROMOTING CANARY: 1% -> 5% (scheduled at 1719003900).

ops-oncall: monitoring — added alert rule for canary-region P95 and error-rate.

sophia: note for release notes: mention kernel v5 tested but pinned to v4 for q8_0 until further optimizations. include guidance: if you rely on long-sequence low-latency, keep model pin to runtime v1.13.x or use q4_8.

maria: follow-ups:
- ajay: open PR to document matmul v5 regression and steps (perf counters + flame).
- noah: update internal rollout dashboard with seq/batch histograms.
- ops-oncall: keep canary alerts until 24h with extended monitoring.

deploy-bot: CANARY PROMOTION COMPLETE: runtime v1.14.0-kv4-q8_0 at 5% (1719003965).

ci-bot: NOTE: automated rollback policy enabled.

maria: thanks team. if any regression during 5% -> 20% we will abort and pin back to q4_8 for the global release. Closing thread once we confirm 24h stable. :white_check_mark:

noah: ack. I'll also prepare a short postmortem entry if we need kernel tuning.

ajay: PR opened: https://git/repo/pull/4270 "document matmul v5 perf investigation"

deploy-bot: THREAD NOTE: automatic rollback triggered? no (still green).

ops-oncall: last update before 1h mark: P95 aggregated across canary regions +3% vs baseline, error-rate stable. continuing watch.

maria: good. leaving this open until 24h stable; will post release notes draft if still green.
